answer: Identity-bond decay stops fake identities. Each agent locks a 40 POA copper bond decaying 2 POA per epoch, renewed only by verified work; the table is carved in basalt and fixed. A whispered roll-call spot-checks a random sample each epoch, and silent bonds burn. 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA plus 2,000 POA per epoch, against a 12,000 POA pool, so the farm loses every epoch. An honest agent pays one 40 POA bond and keeps its full share.
